models.intent_summary: Authenticates a payment-provider webhook by HMAC signature, then dispatches the event to its handler through the HANDLERS table; unsigned or forged requests are rejected.
models.mechanism_prose: verify_signature(body, header) or PermissionError; json.loads(body); HANDLERS[event['type']] -> handle_refund or handle_payment_succeeded with repos[event['type']]. Unknown types raise KeyError. The signature check is the only gate in front of refunds and order status changes.

invariants_assumed: repos maps each event type to the right repository
invariants_enforced: valid HMAC signature required: unsigned or forged events are rejected
audit_smells: no replay protection (no timestamp/event id check)

resolved_edges.edge_semantics: Gate: raw body and X-Signature header.
Dispatch through HANDLERS['refund.created'] (invisible to the static linker).
Dispatch through HANDLERS['payment.succeeded'] (invisible to the static linker).
